function: Learned PAEnet only estimates delay and Doppler indices of target UAVs from echo OTFS frames, which is radar sensing; no communication link or metric is evaluated (pp. 5, 10-11).
notes: Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Reason function. The learned PAEnet (ESnet, PRnet, Funet) estimates delay and Doppler indices of target UAVs under impulse noise. p. 1: "communication waveform-based UAV sensing situation", so OTFS is only the probing waveform. p. 5: "OTFS signal and process the echo signal reflected by the" UAV, so the UAV is a passive target and no communication receiver is modeled. p. 10: "the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm for delay Doppler" parameter estimation. pp. 10-11 report only NMSE and a detection rate (p. 11: "The detection rate, defined as the condition where the errors" are below 1); there is no BER, rate or other communication metric. This is sensing alone in a system that does not communicate. If the reviewer reads the OTFS communication waveform as making the system communicate, the nearest area would be 4, but the target is sensing, not data channel estimation or detection, and the method designs no ISAC beam, waveform or resource (area 5).
